comparison.objective: Insert a movable spindle through an electrode-roll core, carry the roll, and deposit both spindle ends on rests.
comparison.physical_skill: Through-core insertion, bimanual load support, suspended-load control, and two-end alignment; no tuning or locking.
comparison.success_condition: Body states genuine bore clearance, sag, both bearing rests, release, and a one-second stable hold, but omits the complete numeric scoring thresholds.
comparison.reason: Tests tool-mediated heavy-roll transfer and support placement.
